description: What changed under a path. Default: files added or modified since `since` (ISO date or relative like 7d, 12h, 2w; default 7d), newest first, from one complete walk (changedAt = newer of original mtime and upload time). With snapshot:'diff' | 'save' (needs PROTON_DRIVE_INDEX=1, which keeps a plaintext file list in the private local index folder): compares against the previous snapshot of that path and reports added, removed, modified and moved (same size and claimed sha1) files; 'save' then stores the current state as the new baseline. An incomplete walk never overwrites a snapshot and omits removed/moved. Changes nothing on Drive.

since.description: ISO date or relative age (7d, 12h, 2w); default 7d. Not with snapshot.

snapshot.description: 'diff' compares with the previous snapshot; 'save' compares, then stores the current state. Needs PROTON_DRIVE_INDEX=1.

name: drive_recent_changes
title: Show recent changes
